# Anatomy kit (vendored)

`iso-kit.mjs` is copied unchanged from https://github.com/wheresryan22/anatomy
(`kit/iso-kit.mjs` at commit 1482e8469b0a9e0d8cc18ea2740a01423d29ae80), MIT licensed (see `LICENSE`).
It has no dependencies and runs only at build time in `scripts/generate-figures.mjs`;
nothing here ships to the browser. Update it by copying the file again.
